page.layout: One block: the title page, centred, one printed line per line, from top to bottom. No running head, page number or catchword.
page.notes: Handwritten marks at the top (a shelf-type note "Eur. 400 (41)" and a stroke) are not printed and are left out. The title is printed in capitals with the same typeface throughout; the "Ad" line is set in a smaller, italic-looking type. No doubtful readings.
